intro: The Scandinavian asks White to prove the gambit was not a sacrifice. The modern repertoire concedes the centre first and takes it back, then fights with the queen off the board. Black plays for the long game, so the practical wins come from accumulating space and the bishop pair, not from forcing a tactic.
